answer: Tie each identity's payout to a witnessed work trail: a new agent's earnings sit in escrow until three randomly drawn long-standing peers re-run a sample of its tasks. Reputation hits its nadir at signup and climbs only as audits pass, so every vertex of a fake ring needs its own audited history. Waiting from dawn to dawn costs an attacker N escrows and N audit fees, growing linearly with every extra identity.
